preconditions.description: The lengths of both bracket sequences s and t must not exceed 200 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in s) and all(c in '()' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both bracket sequences s and t must consist only of the characters '(' and ')'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the shortest regular bracket sequence that contains both s and t as subsequences.
